instruction: I am going to France this weekend, and my check-in bag sums to 22kg so far. Place an amazon order for any 3 identical board games. Make sure the total weight does not exceed the allowed weight for my check-in bag according to my flight confirmation. These are gifts, so get them gift wrapped if there is an option, and send them to my home address.
notes: Two information needs: the check-in allowance from the flight confirmation email (gmail.show_inbox_threads with query 'flight' then gmail.show_thread; asserts found-baggage-allowance) and board-game candidates (amazon.search_products by product_type, amazon.show_product for weight and gift-wrap availability; asserts product-details-known). A single product object stands for the selected board game; the numeric constraint (weight*3 <= allowance-22) and giftability are selection rules recorded in bindings, and add_product_to_cart requires both knowledge predicates. clear_cart_first=true is passed so the order contains only the 3 board games (evaluation demands exactly one order item). Gift wrapping of all 3 units must precede place_order; the order is shipped to the amazon address named Home (no address updates/deletions). supervisor.complete_task takes the product and quantity as non-API record parameters and is forced last via (task-completed).
